summary: The Atkinson County School District’s technology director urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E‑Rate program, rejecting any proposal to sunset, eliminate, or unnecessarily narrow eligibility, and to maintain support for internal network infrastructure. Jeffery Harrell urges the FCC to protect E‑Rate so that all students, regardless of location or family income, can access reliable, affordable, and effective connectivity.
